subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should allowed `tools.elevated.enabled` sessions default to host exec, or should unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` keep sandbox exec as the default until elevation is explicit?
rationale: Both choices affect the sandbox escape boundary and existing operator workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Default Off Elevated Contract
options.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, and host exec requires an explicit directive or per-call elevation path.

options.title: Keep Current Host-Default Contract
options.body: Preserve `on` as the default for allowed elevated sessions and update docs/support guidance to make the sandbox escape explicit.

options.title: Add Separate Opt-In Mode
options.body: Keep current `on`/`ask` semantics but add a distinct sandbox-default mode for per-call elevated host execution.

recommendation.title: Default Off Elevated Contract
recommendation.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, and host exec requires an explicit directive or per-call elevation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The clearest history signal for the current elevated default and exec routing contract is his exec-tool split and elevated-default gating work.
